We write the words of the law to the brothers

The sons take the gifts

The men see the houses of death

A kingdom knows the truth
A man writes commandments and laws

Apostles and churches see life and death
A son of a slave says a parable to a church

A brother writes a law and a parable to a church
The hearts of men have life and peace

You see gifts and temples
A church writes the word of life
He says a parable and a law to the hearts of men
The son of an apostle writes to a church

ru_to_el: The kingdom has glory.
The churches say parables to the hearts of men.
The voice of the Son of Man teaches the apostle, and the voice of the apostle teaches the man.
We have the writings of the apostles.
The man sees life and death.
The apostles untie the souls.
We see the houses and the temples.
Jesus knows the hearts of men.
We know the voices of the churches, the words of the truth and the souls of men.
The churches have peace and glory.

el_to_ru: The church is good, and the kingdom is bad
The bad heart of the man knows death
The apostles see the small houses and the bad roads
The bad slaves destroy the house of the apostle
The bad people destroy the temple
The Lord of life raises the dead
The words of the truth teach others too
The righteous virgins receive the good gifts of the Lord
The bad man sees the desert and the last houses
The slaves are first and the lords are last
The Lord writes a good word to the small church
The faithful man sees the faithful men
The bad slaves are last and the good sons are first
The son of the last brother sees the good churches of the Lord
We say another parable to the bad virgin
The church is first and the kingdom is last
The Lord says a good parable to the faithful women and to the faithful men
The good man writes good things and the bad man writes bad things
The slave is good and says good things
The truth is faithful and the men are bad
ru_to_el: The Lord writes the first parable to the first church.
The good virgin sees the roads of the desert.
Good things are first, and bad things are last.
Death is bad, and life is good.
The Lord of the kingdom raises the faithful men and the faithful women.
Good people know bad people, and bad people know good people.
We say good words to the church, but people write a bad word.
The good virgins see the bad road.

el_to_ru: The disciples of the prophets remain in the world
The bad people throw stones into the house of the disciples
God sends the angels into the world
The prophet sends the disciples of the Lord out of the houses into the church
God raises the dead out of death
You take the good gifts from the virgins
We lead the children out of the houses
After the angels God sends the Son
With the angels the Lord leads the righteous into heaven
Through the roads of the desert the slaves carry the gifts into another place
Through the writings of the prophets we know the Lord
For the sake of the glory of God the Lord raises the dead
They carry the dead into the desert
The disciples teach the good children in the church
The Lord says a parable to the disciples in the temple
For the sake of the truth the prophets see death
Out of the desert the baptists lead the good young men and the sons of the prophets to the small houses of the disciples
For the sake of the kingdom of God we bear bad things
On account of the souls of the brothers he sees bad things
Heaven is good and the world is bad
The young men see the baptist in the desert
ru_to_el: In the world we have death, and in the church life.
The good woman sends the virgin and the children to the great prophets.
The little child throws a stone into the beautiful house.
The baptist says a good word to the young men and leads the disciples to the Lord.
The disciples remain in the church and say a parable to the others.
Through the voice of the prophet the Lord teaches the disciples.
On account of the commandments of God the disciples write good words to the brothers.
For the sake of the children the prophet sends the bad young men into the desert.
After the Lord the apostle leads the disciples.
The prophets teach the young men with the children.
The good women carry the children to the Lord, and the bad women lead them into the world.
The Lord with the prophet remain in another place.
The righteous lead the disciples through the desert to the Lord.
We see the life of the Son of God in this world.
You are bad, and the church is good.
Through the word of God the Lord raises the dead.

el_to_ru: Your disciples know the kingdom and lead their brothers into it
I teach my judges and say a parable to them
The Lord leads me to his disciples
Because of me you see death, and I say bad words to you
Through you God leads the faithful into his kingdom, and through them the others
For our sake the Lord remains in the world
I am a slave, and you are a master
The Lord is good, and you are good
You are disciples of the Lord and brothers of his apostles
The master is faithful, but his slaves are bad
The church is faithful, and we see it
We see you and say a parable to you
We are slaves, and we teach slaves
Our slaves see us, and we teach them
From you my brother receives good gifts, and he sends them to me through his slaves
We know the road, and through it we lead you into our house
With our brothers we see the disciples of our Lord
After the bad days we see the kingdom of our Lord
With you we say a parable to the tax collectors
ru_to_el: Your disciples are in the house of the Lord.
My brothers are in the desert.
The prophet knows the tax collectors and leads them to the judge.
Through his word you have glory.
Because of your children you know the bad days.
In our days the world is evil.
God knows our souls and sets them free from death.
You are my son and my disciple.
We are in the kingdom of God with your faithful disciples.
We say a parable to you, but you say another word to us.
The way is bad, but we lead the children to the Lord.
My Lord carries gifts for you, but you write a bad word to him.
My houses are bad, and your disciples lead the children out of it.
Your disciples lead their brothers to me.
I see and know my sons and lead them to the Lord.
God knows his church and leads it out of death into his kingdom.
Your commandments are good and righteous and lead us into life.
Our Lord sends his apostles to you.
We send our slaves into your houses, but you take our gifts from us.
You are good, but your disciples are bad.

el_to_ru: These teachers judge the judge himself
And the same young man has the same joy in his heart
Now I myself receive the same gospel from my Lord
This one sees that one and judges him
After this you yourselves have the love of the Lord in your hearts
These have joy, but those have sin
And this is the voice of his master
Thus we know this one and see his face
We receive these gifts from the same man and see him
You yourself baptize that one and are his brother
Into the same church we lead these good teachers of ours
I myself have this promise of my Lord
This virgin sees the face of her Lord
This woman knows the truth itself
Your promise is good, and this one is good
Those are disciples of the same teacher
This one is the teacher of that one, and that one of this one
This baptist teaches good people and is himself good
After those days we are teachers of these slaves
With the faithful prophets we have good promises, but the evil tax collectors see bad days
ru_to_el: These prophets know the Lord himself.
The same disciples know him and see his face.
Those churches judge these teachers and lead them from sin into joy.
We ourselves have this sin in our heart.
Because of the love of our Lord these young men and these virgins have joy in their hearts.
These are the faithful disciples of the prophet.
The apostle himself baptizes his brothers and leads them to you.
Through this gospel we have life in the heavens.
Because of these teachers we see death in the church.
He himself knows us, and from him we receive this promise and the same joy.
Because of this same gospel we ourselves send these tax collectors to you.
He sends the Lord himself into this world.
I myself see this righteous judge, and his brothers see him.
Now we baptize those disciples of our Lord and send them into the desert.
My disciples know my voice and bring these children to me.
We are disciples of the Lord, but you are disciples of the evil one.
This love leads our children into life.
The love of these churches leads other people into joy too.
The teachers of this world have sin in their hearts and so teach people.
I know the sin of these tax collectors and send them to the Lord himself.

el_to_ru: These slaves are set free by the Lord
By the word of the Lord we are led into the church of God
You do not hear the voice of the prophet, but you go out of his house
By the word of the Lord himself you become his disciples

God himself rules his kingdom
The church has peace and joy, because it is saved by its Lord
We do not answer the tax collector, because we know him
You are saved from your sins not by the disciples, but by God himself
You do not go in the bad way, but you are saved from your sins, and your brothers hear the voice of the Lord
The Lord comes into the house of his disciple
We come to the apostles, because we know their voice
With his brothers he is led into the kingdom of God by the voice of the apostles
You do not become a disciple of the Lord, because you do not enter his church
These judges judge those robbers by the law
These good virgins are persecuted by these robbers on the way, but the Lord saves them
The baptist himself goes out of the house and departs from the evil people
ru_to_el: These churches are saved by the Lord from death.
I am saved by him, and he teaches me by his word.
We become disciples of the apostle, but you do not hear his voice.
I am a sinner, but I am taught by the apostles of the Lord and have his promises.
I am a bad slave, but you become my teacher.
Evil people say to those churches that our brothers do not see the face of the Lord.
We know the Lord, because we receive good gifts from him and are taught by him through parables.
You write to your brothers that you are persecuted by evil judges.
He teaches others and is himself taught by this apostle.
This disciple does not answer that prophet, because he does not know his writings.
You say to that church that you are a bad slave.
You remain in this temple, but you are not disciples of the Lord.
We do not see the faces of these tax collectors and sinners.
In the house of the disciples of our Lord there is peace and joy.
The Lord rules this world by his word.
These sinners do not enter the house of the Lord, but they go out into the desert with the robbers.
These writings are written by the Lord to his faithful churches through the prophets.

el_to_ru: We heard his voice in those days, but now we no longer hear it
And the disciple of the Lord was speaking a parable to his brothers
The robbers were killing the children together with their teachers beside this road
Then they were going down into the house, but now I no longer go down
You were receiving the bread from the slaves and eating it
For the sake of the truth the prophets were dying in those days
This apostle was gathering the disciples of your Lord into the church
Now we are taught by the apostles, but then we ourselves were teaching the church
Our Lord took away our sins
Then they were going up into the temple, but now they no longer go up
You were evil, but now you are good
You are good, but we are evil
Then I was in the temple, and the Lord was teaching me
We say to you that we were in your house
You were throwing them out of the temple
The tax collectors were sending their slaves to me
The Lord was sending angels to us
He was in the world, and the world did not see him

el_to_ru: These words were written in the book of the Lord
I was being taught by him from the books of the prophets
In those days we were both being taught by him and teaching others, but now we are neither taught nor teach
The sinners were departing to the sea
The church was going out to him, but now it no longer goes out

Around him his glory was seen
The gifts were being carried to the evil masters too

The disciples were gathering to him
The works of the evil one are evil
Neither is he himself evil, nor are his works evil
The Lord was dying for his church
A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a slave above his lord
In the boat they were carrying them to the Lord across the sea
You were going out of your houses
These demons were going out through his word
They were being heard and were hearing; they are being heard and are hearing
I was coming to the Lord, and I was also leading other sinners

Neither is he himself evil, nor are his works evil.

A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a slave above his lord.

el_to_ru: The Lord will lead his disciples into the kingdom
I will know both the good and the evil
You will take the boats out of the sea
You will set the slaves free
The evil will have neither joy nor peace
In that hour the Son of Man will come with his angels
You are sinners, but you will become disciples of the Lord
The evil persecute the prophets, but in the days of the Son of Man they will no longer persecute them
You will pray to your God and glorify him
Then you will know that he is the Lord
Even I will not know this
The slaves of sin will teach the people of this world, but the faithful teacher will teach me
The apostles will take those things, and the other disciples these
Through the word of the Lord these blind men will see again
The prophet himself will write this in the Scriptures
Bad days will come
And you too will go into the ways of the evil and so teach other people
They too will preach the gospel in this evil world
She too will come to him, and he will teach her
The gospel was preached in the bad days, and it is preached now too, but on that day the Lord himself will come
ru_to_el: The Lord will lead his disciples into the kingdom.
You will take the boats out of the sea.
You will set the slaves free.
The evil will have neither joy nor peace.
You are sinners, but you will become disciples of the Lord.
Then you will know that he is the Lord.
Through the word of the Lord these blind men will see again.
Bad days will come.
She too will come to him, and he will teach her.
The gospel was preached in the bad days, and it is preached now too, but on that day the Lord himself will come.

el_to_ru: The Lord set his slave free, but the slave did not set another free
These have already turned to the Lord, but those will turn in the bad days
We believed in the Lord, and he will save us
And you believed in him, and you will believe
You returned to the Lord, and he received you into his church
In those days you were walking in the evil ways
You turned to the Lord, and he healed you
Those are evil, but we persuaded them
I have prepared a place for you in heaven
I received you into my house, but these evil people did not receive you
The blind men saw again
They themselves were evil, and they sent evil men into the church
You taught me in the temple
Then we heard these commandments, and we will hear others in the church
In that hour they will go out of the world, but then they received us
They heard him and marvelled
You received the gospel, but these will not receive it
You neither listened to the Lord nor believed in him
ru_to_el: The Lord set his slave free, but the slave did not set another free.
We believed in the Lord, and he will save us.

I have prepared a place for you in heaven.

el_to_ru: And we saw the Lord and heard his words
You neither entered their houses nor said a parable to them
In that hour they became disciples of the Lord
These became good disciples, but those are still evil
They were bringing the blind to him
The evil angels fell out of heaven
You cast out the demons, but you healed the children
You gathered the evil into your houses, and we the good
You did not preach the gospel in the church, for you did not become a disciple
Now you say good words, but they said the same words in those days too
We believed in the Lord, for the disciples led us to him
This I said to you in the temple, but that I do not yet say
Then you entered the church, and on that day you will enter heaven
Then we will see the Lord in his glory, for we believed in him
The Lord then went out of the world, but his disciples still remain in it
These commandments I received from the Lord
Then you received the promise from the Lord, and now you preach it in the world too
You came to the Lord and received this from him
He himself gathered us into his church
People saw the Son of God, for he became a man and remained in this world
ru_to_el: And we saw the Lord and heard his words.
In that hour they became disciples of the Lord.
You cast out the demons, but you healed the children.
We believed in the Lord, for the disciples led us to him.
Then we will see the Lord in his glory, for we believed in him.
The Lord then went out of the world, but his disciples still remain in it.
These commandments I received from the Lord.
You came to the Lord and received this from him.

el_to_ru: We believed in the Lord and were known by him
This was written in the books
You taught the children, but you yourselves were also taught by the Lord; the word of God was spoken by the prophet

We went to the other place, because these will not receive us
God was glorified by the Son, and he glorified him
The gospel was preached in those days, and it will be preached now too
A place will be prepared for you in heaven according to the promise of the Lord
The children were brought to the Lord
These saw the face of the Lord and heard his voice
In the small house the voice of the apostle will be heard
I am the first of sinners, but I too was saved
We will see the angels, and we ourselves will be seen by them
ru_to_el: We believed in the Lord and were known by him.
The faithful were taken into heaven, and the evil angels were cast out of it.
The dead will be raised by the word of the Lord.

The sinners were saved in that hour and became disciples of the Lord.
